name: manual_5c3598
claim: When supervising child processes via HTTP loopback proxies under spend bounds, enforce five structural patterns: (1) Synchronous socket admission in process_request before spawning handler threads; (2) Three-phase lifecycle (RUNNING -> DRAINING -> CLOSED) where stop_and_drain marks CLOSED on timeout to fence chat_gate dispatch; (3) Single fail-closed funnel classifying outcomes as ACCOUNTED, REJECTED (DEFINITIVE_REJECTIONS), or UNACCOUNTED (debited in full and exiting 124); (4) Pre-forward provider-side budget clamping of max_tokens and max_completion_tokens; (5) Per-launch random session token authentication. On distributed task queues, preserve task_claims.claimed_at fencing tokens made strictly increasing via persistent task_claim_hwm table and nextafter(), requiring --expected-claimed-at or --unverified-legacy on worker CLI.

decisions.notes: Supersedes lesson_f7c090a572fc. Refines monotonic claim token claims to strictly increasing high-water-mark fencing stamps via task_claim_hwm and math.nextafter, worker CLI required fence flags, and codifies five loopback proxy lifecycle and accounting invariants.
